cause: Expanded single-field record arrays retain their canonical source_owner_span on a leaf, but static typed target resolution treated each field as one isolated record. Interior cursor arithmetic lost the original array extent despite complete homogeneous member declarations.
implementation: Validate source-owner bounds, exact packed record stride, all scalar field leaves, declared pointer domains and compatible aliases. Missing, conflicting, mixed-domain or partial spans do not produce an array view. Crossing declarations are checked, including starts before the owner.

Build one temporary source-coordinate index and sparse derived views per immutable native lookup. Carry admitted extents through existing typed array/index/cursor, stack, call and join machinery. No target constants, guessed pointers, new per-node arrays or transfer recognizer.

The newly exposed field-plus-size expression also reproduced a separate assembler defect: symbolic base-relative expressions used a single-label-sized prefix and a64-byte rewritten operand. Preserve complete expression text within the existing256-byte line bound; reject oversize input/reconstruction rather than silently truncate.

native_operation_counts.complexity: O(N log N + K log N + visited members), with sorted candidate deduplication; N policy items, K candidate owners. Sparse views reuse existing typed values; no dense per-instruction storage.

validation.performance_scope: One necessary changed-analysis qualification, not a controlled speed benchmark. No performance improvement claimed. Parser-only reassembly reused identical retained source and took less than one second; no second analysis generation.
